added.description_zh:
記錄個案診斷此癌症時之實足年
齡。
000：小於1歲
001：1歲，但是小於2歲
002：2歲
…：填入診斷年齡
120：120歲
999：診斷年齡不詳。
added.description_en: Record the actual age of diagnosis for this cancer. 000: Less than 1 year old 001: 1 year old but less than 2 years old 002: 2 years old … Fill in the diagnosed age 120: 120 years old 999: Age at diagnosis not specified.

added.description_zh:
YYYYMMDD：最初診斷日期是指此癌症最早被醫師診斷的日期。
99999999：最初診斷日期不詳
年不詳：9999
月不詳：99
日不詳：99。
added.description_en: YYYYMMDD：Initial diagnosis date refers to the earliest date when a physician diagnosed this cancer. 99999999：Initial diagnosis date unknown Year unknown: 9999 Month unknown: 99 Day unknown: 99.

added.description_zh: 收錄實質腫瘤於首次治療前的分級/分化，描述腫瘤和正常組織的相似程度。各癌別編碼原則詳欄位(變項)譯碼(二十)【分級/分化對照表(1) 臨床分級/分化(GRADE_C)對照表】。
added.description_en: Records the grade/differentiation of the solid tumor prior to first treatment, describing how similar the tumor is to normal tissue. Coding principles vary by cancer type; see field (variable) coding (20) [Grade/differentiation lookup table (1) clinical grade/differentiation (GRADE_C) lookup table].

added.description_zh: 收錄實質腫瘤於原發部位手術之後的分級/分化，描述腫瘤和正常組織的相似程度。各癌別編碼原則請詳欄位(變項)譯碼(二十)【分級/分化對照表(2) 病理分級/分化(GRADE_P)對照表】。
added.description_en: Records the grade/differentiation of solid tumors after surgery at the primary site, describing how closely the tumor resembles normal tissue. For coding rules by cancer site, see field (variable) code table (20) [Grade/differentiation lookup table (2) Pathological grade/differentiation (GRADE_P) lookup table].

added.description_zh:
組織病理：使用ICD-O-3之組織病理碼(Morphology)譯碼
第5碼為2：原位癌
第5碼為3：侵襲癌
added.description_en: Pathology: ICD-O-3 tissue morphology code, 5th digit 2: in situ carcinoma, 5th digit 3: invasive carcinoma

added.description_zh:
依ICD-O-3腫瘤部位碼 (topography code)進行原發部位編碼。
NHL(非何杰金氏淋巴瘤)、HL(何杰金氏淋巴瘤)及LEU(白血病)等血液腫瘤個案，在此欄位無法辨識，請用組織類型與性態碼(HISTBEH)區分。若是要分析各癌症部分(CASITE欄位)，也請先把NHL、HL、LEU等血液腫瘤排除後再計算。
added.description_en: Topography code (ICD-O-3) is used for primary site coding. Cases of NHL (non-Hodgkin lymphoma), HL (Hodgkin lymphoma), and LEU (leukemia) cannot be identified in this field; please use histological type and behavior code (HISTBEH) to distinguish. If analyzing cancer sites (CASITE field), please exclude NHL, HL, and LEU cases first.

added.description_zh:
YYYYMMDD：個案因此癌症至申報醫院門診或住院之最早日期。
99999999：個案首次到申報醫院就診日期不詳。年不詳：9999 月不詳：99 日不詳：99。
added.description_en: YYYYMMDD: The earliest date of outpatient or inpatient visit to the reporting hospital due to this cancer. 99999999: Unclear about the first visit date to the reporting hospital for this cancer case. Year unclear: 9999 Month unclear: 99 Day unclear: 99.

added.name_zh: 首次顯微鏡檢證實日期
added.description_zh:
YYYYMMDD：指此癌症最早顯微鏡檢證實的日期。
00000000：個案未做顯微鏡檢檢查
99999999：不清楚個案是否有接受顯微鏡檢檢查、「首次顯微鏡檢證實日期」期不詳。
年不詳：9999 月不詳：99 日不
詳：99。
added.description_en: YYYYMMDD: refers to the date when this cancer was first confirmed under microscopic examination. 00000000: patient did not undergo microscopic examination 99999999: unclear whether the patient underwent microscopic examination or 'first microscopic confirmation date' is unknown. Year unknown: 9999 Month unknown: 99 Day unknown: 99

added.description_zh:
YYYYMMDD：記錄個案在申報醫院最早針對癌症進行手術的日期。
00000000：沒有進行任何手術、於屍體解剖時才診斷為癌症。
99999999：不知道個案是否有接受手術治療、個案有接受手術治療但是接受手術治療的日期不清楚、僅由死亡證明書得知個案有癌症。
年不詳：9999 月不詳：99 日不
詳：99。
added.description_en: YYYYMMDD: records the earliest date on which the case underwent cancer-related surgery at the reporting hospital. 00000000: no surgery was performed; cancer was diagnosed only at autopsy. 99999999: unknown whether the case received surgical treatment; the case received surgical treatment but the date is unknown; or the case's cancer was known only from the death certificate. Year unknown: 9999. Month unknown: 99. Day unknown: 99.

added.name_zh: 申報醫院原發部位手術方式
added.description_zh:

(OPTYPE)對照表】。
added.description_en: Records the surgical method performed on the primary site at the reporting hospital; see field (variable) coding (4) [Reporting hospital primary-site surgery method (OPTYPE) cross-reference table].

added.description_zh:
記錄在申報醫院的首次療程中，進行放射治療的開始日期，詳欄位(變項)譯碼(五)【放射治療開始日期
(RTB_DT)對照表】。
added.description_en: Records the start date of radiation therapy during the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital; see field (variable) coding explanation (5) [Radiation Therapy Start Date (RTB_DT) Table].

added.description_zh: 記錄個案於申報醫院首次療程中，所給予化學治療相關情形，詳欄位(變項)譯碼(七)【申報醫院化學治療(CH)對照表】。
added.description_en: Records the chemotherapy given to the case during the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital; see field (variable) coding explanation (7) [Reporting hospital chemotherapy (CH) reference table].

added.name_zh: 申報醫院化學治療開始日期
added.description_zh: 詳欄位(變項)譯碼(八)【申報醫院化學治療開始日期(CH_DT)對照表】。
added.description_en: See field (variable) coding explanation (8) [Chemotherapy start date at reporting hospital (CH_DT) correspondence table].

added.name_zh: 申報醫院荷爾蒙/類固醇治療
added.description_zh: 記載個案在申報醫院首次療程中，所給予荷爾蒙治療的相關情形，詳欄位(變項)譯碼(九)【申報醫院荷爾蒙治療(HORM)對照表】。
added.name_zh_en: hospital report of hormone / corticosteroid treatment
added.description_en: Records hormone therapy given to the case during the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital; see field (variable) coding (9) [Reporting Hospital Hormone Therapy (HORM) table].

added.name_zh: 申報醫院荷爾蒙/類固醇治療開始日期
added.description_zh: 詳欄位(變項)譯碼(十)【申報醫院荷爾蒙治療開始日期(HORM_DT)對照表】。
added.name_zh_en: Reported hospital hormone / steroid therapy start date
added.description_en: See field (variable) coding explanation (10) [Reporting Hospital Hormone Therapy Start Date (HORM_DT) Table].

added.description_zh: 記載申報醫院於首次療程中，所給予免疫治療的相關情形，詳欄位(變項)譯碼(十一)【申報醫院免疫治療(IMMU)對照表】。
added.description_en: Records details of immunotherapy given during the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital; see field (variable) coding (11) [Reporting hospital immunotherapy (IMMU) lookup table].

added.description_en: See field (variable) coding (12) [Reporting Hospital Immunotherapy Start Date (IMMU_DT) table].

added.name_zh: 申報醫院骨髓/幹細胞移植或內分泌處置

added.description_en: See field (variable) coding explanation (14) [Start date of bone marrow/stem cell transplant or endocrine treatment at reporting hospital (BM_DT) correspondence table].

(TARGET)對照表】。
added.description_en: Records whether targeted therapy was given during the case's first treatment at the reporting hospital; see field (variable) coding (15) [Reporting hospital targeted therapy (TARGET) cross-reference table].

added.description_en: See field (variable) coding explanation (16) [Reporting Hospital Targeted Therapy Start Date (TARGET_DT) Table].

added.description_zh: 申報醫院為緩解或減輕個案症狀所提供之照護，包括手術治療、放射治療、全身性治療(化學治療、荷爾蒙治療或其他全身性藥物)及疼痛控制治療，詳欄位(變項)譯碼(十七)【申報醫院緩和照護(PALLI)對照表】。
added.description_en: Care provided by the reporting hospital to relieve or reduce the case's symptoms, including surgical treatment, radiotherapy, systemic therapy (chemotherapy, hormone therapy, or other systemic drugs), and pain control treatment; see field (variable) coding (17) [Reporting hospital palliative care (PALLI) cross-reference table].

added.description_zh:
記錄個案在任何醫療機構的首次療程中，所給予其他治療相關情形。其他治療的定義為未能歸類於手
術、放射治療、全身性藥物治療或輔助性治療(ancillarytreatment) ，詳欄位(變項)譯碼(十八)【其他治療(OTHER)對照表】。
added.description_en: Records other therapy given to the case during the first course of treatment at any medical institution. Other therapy is defined as therapy that cannot be classified as surgery, radiation therapy, systemic drug therapy, or ancillary treatment; see field (variable) coding explanation (18) [Other Therapy (OTHER) Table].

4：雙側侵犯但起源之側位不清楚，且病歷描述是單一原發(較少見) 。․雙側卵巢同時有單一組織類型之腫瘤侵犯。

․雙側同時有Wilm 腫瘤(Wilm tumors)。
5：成對器官，位於身體中線的腫瘤。
9：成對器官，但其側位不清楚。
